notes: First colon is a verbless possessive clause; *keep* is read as the relational verb written where the copula of the לְ predicate would stand (rules 43/49), with the `added` reading and the light-verb reading named in the unit note.
*Hold thy peace* is one fixed rendering of תֶּחֱרַשׁ; the *thy* inside it is read as part of the idiom (rule 30), competing reading `added` under rule 18 recorded.
